Title: Register new user with valid details
Steps: 1. Open register page 2. Fill all required fields 3. Submit
ExpectedResult: User redirected to login or success state

Title: Login and verify profile
Steps: 1. Login with valid credentials 2. Open profile page
ExpectedResult: Profile shows correct name and email

Title: Login with invalid password
ExpectedResult: Error message displayed user not logged in

Title: Add multiple products and update quantity
Steps: 1. Add product A 2. Add product B 3. Update quantity on cart
ExpectedResult: Cart shows both items with updated quantity

Title: Checkout with Cash on Delivery
Preconditions: User logged in cart has items
Steps: 1. Proceed checkout 2. Select COD 3. Finish order 4. Confirm twice

Title: Generate invoice and verify in My Invoices
Steps: 1. Complete COD checkout 2. Confirm twice 3. Open My Invoices

Title: Checkout with empty cart
ExpectedResult: Empty cart state or no checkout allowed
